It's Sunday morning and you turn on your tv...
to a Home Shopping Channel?

"The Curio Compendium." 
"Curious oddities and antiques for everyday needs!"

[From [url=https://zetareishi.itch.io/curio-compendium-ch0]itch.io[/url]]
